issues.description: The template Lecture constructor signature (accepting only lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents) does not match the constructor required by the problem statement/UML and the solution (which include numberOfLecturers and numberOfTutors in that exact order). This prevents students from implementing/initializing all attributes as specified and will cause confusion when following the UML and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Lecture class to match the UML and solution: declare the five attributes (lectureName: String, numberOfInscribedStudents: int, numberOfGuestStudents: int, numberOfLecturers: int, numberOfTutors: int) and change the constructor signature to public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and initialize all fields in that order. This aligns the template with the problem statement and solution and removes the blocker for students.
